title: Display practice time in seconds with smart formatting
description: Dashboard currently shows practice time in minutes but user wants more granular display. Show time in seconds for small amounts, then smart-format as it grows: 0-59s show '45s', 60s-59m show '5m 30s', 1h+ show '1h 15m'. Store time internally in milliseconds for precision, display with appropriate unit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Practice time stored internally in milliseconds (or seconds with decimals)
Display '1h 15m' for times 1 hour and above
